source_text: In the UK context leading to 1985 legislation, medical consensus, including from bodies like the British Medical Association, rejected any equivalence to male circumcision or medical justification, viewing FGM as non-therapeutic mutilation inflicting irreversible harm on minors incapable of consent, akin to child abuse rather than cultural relativism.
